_note: Crawler-trap bait. PATHS are deliberately benign, realistic content routes for a literature/poetry site — chosen so they do NOT match any WAF rule. A real crawler that follows the (hidden) links is logged as ordinary HTTP, not flagged malicious; only genuinely hostile tools that ALSO probe exploit paths get caught by the WAF separately. STRINGS live only in response HTML (comments) — the WAF never sees them — so they exist to look like a lived-in real site (subtle dev cruft / mild lures), never to self-identify as a honeypot.
